name: Audiobookshelf

database.label: Bundled SQLite database, no external database required

resourceFootprint.notes: Light at idle — around 125 MB of RAM with a small library in our test LXC. Scanning large libraries and transcoding for some clients temporarily raise CPU and RAM use; storage needs depend entirely on your audiobook and podcast collection.

dockerComposeSnippet:
services:
  audiobookshelf:
    image: ghcr.io/advplyr/audiobookshelf:latest
    container_name: audiobookshelf
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "13378:80"
    environment:
      TZ: 'Europe/Sofia'
    volumes:
      - ./audiobooks:/audiobooks
      - ./podcasts:/podcasts
      - ./config:/config
      - ./metadata:/metadata
descriptionEn: Audiobookshelf is a self-hosted audiobook and podcast server with a polished web player and official Android and iOS apps. It scans your folders, pulls in covers and metadata, tracks listening progress per user and syncs it across devices, with support for multiple libraries, series, collections and podcast auto-download. If you own DRM-free audiobooks or listen to public-domain recordings, it gives you an Audible-like experience on your own hardware.
descriptionBg: Audiobookshelf е self-hosted сървър за аудиокниги и подкасти с добре изработен уеб плейър и официални приложения за Android и iOS. Сканира папките ти, изтегля корици и метаданни, следи прогреса на слушане за всеки потребител и го синхронизира между устройствата, с поддръжка на няколко библиотеки, серии, колекции и автоматично сваляне на подкасти. Ако имаш аудиокниги без DRM или слушаш записи от обществено достояние, получаваш Audible-подобно изживяване на собствен хардуер.
taglineEn: Self-hosted audiobook and podcast server with mobile apps.
taglineBg: Self-hosted сървър за аудиокниги и подкасти с мобилни приложения.
